subject: general
question: The Citadel and Great Bath can be traced to which site of the Indus Valley Civilisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohenjo-Daro**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mohenjo-Daro lies on the** bank of the Indus river in the Larkana district of Sindh Province of Pakistan.**</li
